title: Improve Dashboard Header Responsiveness for iPad
body:
This PR improves the responsiveness of the Dashboard screen, specifically targeting layout issues on iPad-sized viewports.

Key changes:
- Updated the header container in `DashboardScreen.tsx` to use `flex-wrap` and `gap-6` to prevent element collision on narrower screens.
- Modified the search bar positioning: it now uses `w-full` and `order-last` on smaller screens to wrap to its own row, while maintaining its absolutely centered position on viewports `lg` and wider.
- Adjusted the main container's padding (`px-6 py-8` on small screens) and vertical spacing (`space-y-8`) to better utilize space on tablets.
- Verified the build and ran relevant unit tests to ensure no regressions.
